text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to obtain approval to install a "No Parking Anytime" regulation on the north side of Burlingame Road, from the first laneway west of Brown's Line to a point 49 metres further west, and on the south side of Burlingame Road from a point 32 metres west of Brown's Line to point 61 metres further west. The proposed parking regulation amendment is being requested by area residents, in consultation with staff and the Ward Councillor, to address excessive parking by non-residents.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Burlingame Road, from a point 32 metres west of Brown's Line to a point 61 metres further west. 2. Prohibited parking at all times on the north side of Burlingame Road, from the first laneway west of Brown's Line to a point 49 metres further west.
